decisions.reason: Locates inject=[apiProxy] and ctx.apiProxy.llm.providers() with line evidence and flags the pinned dsh-host-apiproxy dependency as dead-risk, but never maps to A1-01 (card id left UNRESOLVED) and does not explain llm injection/listProviders as the replacement.

All other categories covered with scanned-file evidence; session-notes.js correctly shown as an unreachable pure-string decoy; cordis.patch.yml treated as ordinary composition (its own R4 config hit is not a host-source patch claim); no invented filename coupling and no denial of the composition file's existence.

Section 6 argues zero hits prove nothing (coverage limits, silent try/catch failure, uninspectable dependency, config surfaces invisible to JS scans) and cleanly separates the decisive apiProxy break from the negative categories.

Proposes post-migration syntax/manifest check (justified no-TS build equivalent), isolated-profile cold boot with loader/config checks, and a functional smoke asserting the success branch of the actual providers call — all as proposed, not executed.
